data.name: Wings of Air
data.description: As a swift action, you can manifest a pair of translucent, cloud-like wings that grant you a fly speed of 60 feet with good maneuverability. You can use these wings for %1 minute(s) per day. This duration does not need to be consecutive, but it must be spent in 1-minute increments.|OracleWingsofAirDuration|!PRECLASS:1,Oracle=10
